## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Tests cover the change (for rules: one schema that triggers it, one that does not)
- [ ] New or changed rules cite official documentation in `source` and set `verified` to the date I read it
- [ ] `docs/rules.md` regenerated with `npm run docs` (if rule metadata changed)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## Unreleased`
